guitar.notes: Accurate: McCready known for Strat, Gossard for Les Paul/various.

tone.target: Voodoo Child-style wah-drenched blues rock crunch
tone.profile: Voodoo Child-style wah-drenched blues rock crunch
tone.summary: A raw, fuzzy signal chain built around a powerful overdrive (OD 9) followed by a Wah pedal, feeding into an AC30-style amp simulation with a classic British cab.
corrections: Shift from mild overdrive to Hendrix-like fuzz

rig.name: Pearl Jam - Yellow Ledbetter - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and noise inherent in high-gain blues tones.
Provide the thick, raw overdrive and fuzz foundation (Plexi/Super Lead emulation).
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used to emulate a classic British preamp boost rather than pure Fuzz Face, but it provides the necessary grit.

blocks.purpose: Implement the prominent wah sweep required for Voodoo Child/Hendrix style blues rock.
Add the necessary thick, aggressive fuzz/overdrive layer for a Hendrix-style tone.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is chosen as the closest available fuzzy distortion to emulate the desired Fuzz Face character without excessive modern digital crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British tone (Plexi/Super Lead) required for blues rock.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound matching the AC30 amp model.
Add a subtle 'liquid' dimension and analog movement to the tone.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is used sparingly here, primarily for texture rather than overt effect, fulfilling the 'liquid sustain' requirement subtly.

blocks.purpose: Add depth and space without sounding overly polished.
Provide a natural, raw room ambience to keep the tone from sounding too dry.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better capture the raw, vintage British sound required for Hendrix/Voodoo Child tones.

proposals.reason: Enhance raw, analog British grit missing from the current digital simulation.
